briefings.title: The SpaceX IPO, Fable 5, AI Capex Update & Market Check w/ Gavin Baker, Andrew Fox & Clark Tang
briefings.tldr: The upcoming SpaceX IPO at $135 per share (implied $1.77 trillion valuation) represents a generational, "must-own" asset, driven not only by the rapid scaling of its core launch and Starlink businesses, but by its sudden, highly profitable emergence as a top-tier terrestrial and orbital AI compute provider.
